status: Prospective engineering verification; no efficacy claim
method: Three shared author TokenLearners pool continuously region-weighted stored memory into auxiliary keys/values. Append to native memory at all four layers. All native spatial tokens, selected frames, temporal encoding, pointers, decoder and presence behavior remain. All original SAM2 parameters frozen in eval mode.
roles: Existing detached within-cell probability variance memberships in background/interior/mixedness order from each stored native low-resolution prediction. These are continuous positional descriptors, not semantic-purity labels or anatomical truth.
position: Author assignment pools the pre-projection memory-position contribution with the same soft memberships. Auxiliary summaries have no single spatial coordinate and join the non-RoPE tail after untouched native pointers. Report auxiliary tokens separately from pointers.
control: Equal parameters, initialization and summary counts; replace per-cell roles with per-frame mean roles. No shuffled control.

prior_work.paper: Scalable Video Object Segmentation with Simplified Framework, ICCV 2023
prior_work.reuse: Unchanged TokenLearnerModuleV11_w_Mask, loaded from verified author source; project supplies region-weighted features and all-one author masks.

Inspected frozen-backbone memory-conditioning and concatenation pattern; its full image wrapper, threshold controller and altered decoder output policy are not used. This integration is not a reproduction of its published method.

checks: Disabled hook reproduces native masks, object scores and autoregressive memory writes bit-for-bit.
Active regional and global arms visit all four layers with the same native spatial/pointer schedule and auxiliary counts.
Original native key/value prefix and pointer RoPE exclusion are preserved; auxiliary summaries are separately counted.
Finite loss and external-module gradients, nonzero gradient through the previous predicted memory write, finite optimizer update.
Original SAM2 parameter digest and source banks remain unchanged; original model has no gradients.
Unit fixture checks independent object batches; real multi-object benchmark remains conditional on a separate instance-aware video gate.
loss: Pinned unchanged SAM2 MultiStepMultiMasksAndIous through decoder_clip_loss; raw masks before native presence suppression, with mask/focal/IoU/objectness supervision.
limits: Appending summaries changes softmax competition even before learning; only disabled hooks are claimed native-identical. Missing-region summaries can learn priors and are not asserted to contain only that region. Short clips prove engineering only, not full-video generalization or Dice improvement.
next: Only after engineering passes, prospectively freeze a bounded sequence-grouped regional versus equal-capacity global training comparison; final-epoch full-video evaluation against compatible official native references, false alarms and paired sequence metrics. PolypGen remains exploratory and patient independence is unverified. Do not reuse these diagnostic weights.
